summary: Answer keys and tajweed facts are sound across all 8 papers; Qur'anic text in options and prompts matches the mushaf except one live word. Two errors, both in the live Ghunna 2: the non-Qur'anic option اُمَّمٌ (real word أُمَمٌ has no shaddah, so no ghunna) is keyed correct, and the Al-Fajr tap key leaves out مَّرْضِيَّةً (89:28) although the video says every meem/noon with shaddah takes ghunna. Systemic: four select_all questions are worded as single-answer or have only one right answer (G1 Q7, G2 Q5, G3 Q7, G5 Q1). Lead-facing why/flags/changes_v2 notes on the end-of-paper WhatsApp tasks (G4, G6, G7) still describe the abandoned in-app recording. All tap/count keys spot-checked word by word; all listen and audio-option timings match QUL's Al-Ḥuṣarī segments. Ghunna 8 is clean.
